title: Abstracts: May 20, 2024
description: Andrey Kolobov discusses WindSeer, a small CNN capable of estimating the wind field around an sUAV in flight more finely and with less compute and data than traditional models. The advancement can help support longer and safer autonomous flights. The post Abstracts: May 20, 2024 appeared first on Microsoft Research .
